method.extraction: The executable is not run. Its ELF section .bun holds Bun's module graph; bunfs.py reads the embedded files from it.
method.evaluation: jseval.py parses the modules with tree-sitter and evaluates upstream's own builder functions over constants. A value that only a running session has is unknown. A condition on an unknown value is taken both ways, and each distinct text is written as a variant with the conditions and answers under `when`. An item with a path that cannot be evaluated is listed under not_captured and no file is written for it.
method.schemas: A tool's input_schema is its declared zod schema converted by zodschema.py, a port of the conversion in the bundle (zod toJSONSchema, draft 2020-12, plus the bundle's wrapper that recomputes `required`). Member order follows the library.
method.environment_variables: A CLAUDE_CODE_* style variable read through the bundle's environment object is treated as unset. The ones read are listed under assumed_unset_environment.
method.feature_flags: A remote flag read as getter("tengu_...", default) evaluates to the default compiled into the bundle. The ones read are listed under feature_flag_defaults. A session whose account has a flag set differently gets different text.

limits: Tool descriptions are prompt() results. Hooks that plugins run on tool descriptions are not applied.

input_schema is the declared schema. Upstream removes some properties when it builds a request (for example agent-team fields, and the `_host` field of remotely executed tools). That step is not applied.
System prompt sections are captured one by one. The order is the order in the assembler's source; which sections a given session includes is decided at run time.
Sections and tools that need session data (memory files, environment report, skills, MCP servers, output styles) are under not_captured.
Only the linux-x64 build was read.
